STIX Two Math 2.13b171 — mathematical symbol subset

Source: https://github.com/stipub/stixfonts/tree/v2.13b171
Original: fonts/static_ttf/STIXTwoMath-Regular.ttf

The application embeds a WOFF2 subset named DSH Math Symbols for U+20E5,
U+2201, U+2ACB, U+2ACC, and U+2AFD. U+2ACB and U+2ACC use 70% of their
original size and a 150-unit baseline lift in the 1000-unit em. The other
outlines are unchanged. Rebuild with fontTools and Brotli from the upstream
TrueType font using the adjacent build-subset.py:

python build-subset.py STIXTwoMath-Regular.ttf STIXTwoMath-Symbols.woff2

Subset SHA-256: 3c4878212467e96121fb39d8ee42eed54940ae8c902893b7d6b5b9d897e2dacc
